matchups.tips: | Bard can really shut him down by ulting him, or his target.
| Her ult makes it hard to lock her down with either your ult or your Q
| Super hard for Bard to shut her down very slippery champ esp when in her W ability.
| Alistar is a free matchup, you only have to respect his lvl 3-6, u win lvl 1-2 and from lvl 6-18 you offer better scaling, better engage and overall more sustain in both healing and dmg.

| If he gets on top of you, you will die, but if you manage to position correctly in teamfights then you can peel your team easily against an Amumu so it? a skill matchup, just look out for his Q as it will now follow no matter if you enter a portal or flash after it hits you.

| Your ult shut down her entire kit, so just make sure to ult her in the beginning in teamfights and you?e golden, you will also have an easy time roaming to her lane as she has no Dashes/blinks to save her life, so it? your job to make Anivia regret his/hers champion choice.

| Annie is easy to engage on as she has no dashes or blinks or spell shields, however, make sure you time her flashes. If you get the jump on Annie then it's easy, but if she gets in a flash ult on your carries then it's very likely that you will lose that fight, so make sure to have great vision around so she can? flank.

| Bard only has 500 range on his AA range, where Aphelios starts with his green weapon Aka the 650 range weapon (even without the sniper he still outranges you with 550 range). So Bard won't be able to poke/engage easily on Aphelios before lvl 6, however, at lvl 6 he is quite an easy target to ult as he has no dashes/blinks. But I would recommend that you only ult in situations where your 1 champion up as Aphelios is one of the few champs that can deal enough damage to burst everyone down.

| She has 100 more range than bard so respect her early game and poke, at lvl 6 it's easy for you to engage on her though as she has no dashes/blinks so just time her flash and repeat kill her with your ult should be easy 2v2 if you hit ult into q.

| He roams just like you so be careful, it is however easy for you to roam to his mid lane and shut him down so make sure to do that whenever you can, don't give Aurelion Sol opportunity to roam bot lane or the game will become very hard.

| It's a pure skill matchup you can stun him the moment he uses his ult but if you don? time it correctly then you might be in a very bad position, try to ult Azir early in a team fight as he has long-range poke and people won? have an easy time to engage on him because of his ult.

| Playing against blitz can be super tough if you get hooked you will die unless u have flash up, you do however out roam him and outscale him so just hang in there and play safe and wait for jungle to help you guys out.
| It's a skill matchup, keep an eye on his cooldowns and play around them, you out roam and outscale so just chill don't overforce anything.

| Dodge his q ability and you won't have any problems with him he is a melee support with no real hard engage so you can even roam without being too scared that they will just all in your adc, sounds fun for Bard!

| She has 650 range so she outranges you by a lot, so laning phase might be super hard for you, however she is easy to hit with ult since every cait main tries to use their e ability out of it, and its legit so slow so they never get out, so wait for your lvl 6 and just keep ulting her.
| You can't really run from her and you can't portal out of her ult so have an eye on her and try to lock her down with your ult and q combo, she is not to be ignored in team fights!

| Playing against Cassiopia can be super tricky as her purple glue will prevent you from portaling out of a fight so be super careful getting stuck in that, besides that when you ult her, expect her to ult right out of your ult, so keep a distance and your back turned at all times!
| It's a skill matchup dodge his abilities and he is useless, get hit by them and you will die, very simple. So stay out of range and keep an eye on his Cooldowns.
| Roam mid as much as you can and make his scaling as slow as you can and try to end the game before he gets to 3 items.
| If you get hooked in by his e it's pretty much over for you, try to play around your portal against him and get some good stuns in, miss and you're dead.
| She is an assassin so have respect for her all in but besides that, it should be ez pz if you're smart and patient.
| Mundo is in a bad spot so not much to fear about, you can kite him easily with your slows and if he is getting on your tail then just portal away and stun him if he follows through it.

| As said Draven is very aggressive and is often played with an all in support to make a kill lane, Bard is very weak against an all-in especially early game where Bard doesn't have a lot of tools to counter it nor survive it, so play safe and wait for your jungler to do stuff!

| Ekko is a dumb champ you basicly have to kill twice because of his broken ult, try to cc chain and burst him to death before he can ult and gain all his hp back, besides that try to get vision around every corner, as he will often try to jump your backline with a properly placed w.

| Respect her early game ganks and wait for her to normally fall off, don't try and ult her in her spider form as she will just repel it, try to land your q in a way where you hit Elise and her spiderling for a nice little stun!
| Get as many pinks as you can around your carries often place them in lane if you're sieging so she can't come from behind, but gl eve is broken and there is not much you can do...

| Ezreal is one of those champs that won't be too deadly for Bard during the laning phase but you won't be able to realy have any kill pressure on the champ as long as he holds his e for your q/r. Be patient and hold them for his e just run up and auto him until he hopefully e?. Ez doesn't get fully online before 3 items, try to get a big enough lead to win before that!
| Keep the corners warded lookout for his ult and try to cancel with your ult or q, besides that he ain? much of a threat if u respect his ult engage.

| Her w is a direct counter to both your q and your ult so be careful of how you use your spells, besides that you need to help your top to get a lead over Fiora or she will split push till she wins the game.
| Ult the person fizz has ulted to counter everything he wants to do, and watch him cry.
| A good bard player will be able to shut down Galio 100% with good ults and q? practice our ult/q timings on his ult.
| You can shut down Garens entire kit with your q and r so don't fear him too much the moment he uses his q you just auto or q for slow so he can't get near you guys.
| Champ is not very good, respect his transform jump but that's it.
| Aftershock/Electrocute Gragas is bad against you, but if he gets Phase Rush, then you have to be careful super hard to land your skills on him.
| Pray that he sucks and try your best to get an ult on him whenever his dash is down!
| Fear his ganks try to stun him on walls when he uses his E to charge in, if you see him ult try to react with ulting the target he is about to ult.
| Easy to set up kills on the dude, but don't fight within his towers unless you're sure that you can stun lock him.
| Dont gank her after lvl 6 it's easier to 1v1 her than 2v1 her.
|  It's your job against Irelia to try and slow her down, meaning ult her stunlock her, not to kill her but to make sure your team has time to deal with everyone else before she joins up.
| Champ sucks respect his early game that's it.
| Janna outranges you so the laning phase is super hard, she is also quite quick so u need to try and auto her before u can hit your q? or ults.
| Respect his early ganks and stand close to walls when he ults you so you can still portal out.
| Try to shut him down early so he doesn't snowball into the unkillable god he can become!
|  For the same reason, Bard is good with him, is also the same reason he is a big threat to Bard and his comp.
| Super easy champ to engage on, but super fast in team fights making it harder to shut him down, so look to engage on Jhin before a fight starts.

| Super hard to deal with during the laning phase as she just flat out range u and u should never be able to hit much stuff on her until you hit LVL 6, when you get your ult though is the moment u can start setting your team up, as she has no dashes/blinks or whatever.
| Respect his W major dmg, and range buff, pressure him when it's down, when u hit lvl 6 it should be easy kills as he can only use flash to escape a proper placed ult.

| Make sure to go Guardian and unflinching vs Leona, it's a skill matchup but you have many ways to counter her, her E will always make her land/appear behind her target, you can use this info to your advantage, stand close to a wall and use your q backwards into the wall when she uses her E on you, this will guarantee a stun before she can use her Q on you, now she is in a bad position and you should win the trade.

| She does more dmg than you, and scales just as well as you or even better depending on her team comp. Make sure to play around cd and vision and wait for ur lvl 6 for hard engages, she can't escape it without flashing it, make sure to hit stun after ult to 100-0 her so she doesn't get a chance to E and R as it will buy a lot of time and often you will lose the fight if that happens.

| How hard the matchup is really dependant on your experience playing against Maokai, Maokai is listed as a champ great into Bard since he has way better objective control than Bard has, and his laning phase is a tad better, but there is ways to counter him. Bait out his w and quickly enter the portal to take him with you into ur turret, and then quickly stun, he will either die or be forced to flash.

| If Morgana is smart she maxes her spellshield first and it becomes a hard game, luckily most Morganas are not smart and they there for max q. Bard q counts as 2 spells, so if bard q dmg breaks the shield and then connects to a wall,minion or champ then it will still stun.

| Nami laning phase can be a bit annoying early game as her trade pattern beats yours, but the moment you hit lvl 6, you just start perma forcing with your ult. She can never match your roams either and you outscale her as well. So overall you're happy.

| Nautilus can be a scary lane, if he catches you then you die. But if you play the lane correctly then you should win. You want to play in the minion wave, making it hard for him to land a hook and always stay close to a wall to use your e to peel yourself or your adc.
|  It's a skill matchup you outscale so even if you only go even or even a bit behind during early game it won? matter, as Pyke is a terrible champion currently and can't teamfight compared to Bard.

| the champs range isn't impressive and she needs a few items before she becomes dangerous, the only thing you have to look out for is her passive jump, try to figure out her jump pattern to figure out when to use your q.

| She has a way better laning phase than you, and she scales just as well as you do or even better into teamfights, her q range is further than your q and auto range. Try to punish her when she pokes your adc, never step up when her spells are ready, wait for the to go on cd.

| He is weak early game as long as you don't get hit by every q, play with vision and try to punish him for farming as much as you can, locket build fully counters him combined with being able to ult low hp targets to save them. Fun matchup.

| Kassadin isn't the biggest threat as long as you keep up with where he might flank from with his ult. Try to predict where he will go with your q or r to pin him down in teamfights. If you can't roam to his lane and kill him then you have to do it once before he hits lvl 6 to put him behind the exp/gold curve he wants to follow.
| Easy to punish only an issue if she gets giga fed and even then locket and easy stuns will shut her down in fights.
| She isn't a threat and she is a sitting duck for your ult as she only has a small ms buff to escape them, Focus kayle in teamfights everytime and it's an easy win.

| You can't do much besides ulting the person he is ulting, and try to hit your q on him while he is using his e in the wall, but it's super hard, so it's quite a skill matchup better player will win.
|  It's easy for you to shut down his gameplay, the moment you see him wanting to engage ult him.

| Kaisa is low range, just like Bard so you can easily trade her without her auto spacing you, She does however have a lot of burst so if she is paired up with an engage support you will die if you're not careful. Make sure to trade when cds are down and inside of the minion wave so her q isn't isolated on you!
